mapper.insert: insert into promotion_rule(rule_name, rule_content, remark) values(#{ruleName}, #{ruleContent}, #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete r from promotion_rule r left join (select r.rule_id,count(*) as count from promotion_rule r join med_exam_package p on r.rule_id = p.promotion_id group by r.rule_id) t on r.rule_id = t.rule_id where r.rule_id = #{ruleId} and t.count is null
mapper.select: select rule_id as ruleId, rule_name as ruleName from promotion_rule;

select count(*) from promotion_rule r
and r.rule_name like concat('%', #{ruleName}, '%')
select rule_id as ruleId, rule_name as ruleName, rule_content as ruleContent, remark from promotion_rule where rule_id = #{ruleId}
